answer: We prove Sybil resistance by showing that personalized EigenTrust attenuation across a sparse cut yields a conductance bound by delta, strictly isolating adversarial clusters. To enforce this, honest validators commit staking collateral subject to zero-knowledge slashing penalties, guaranteeing a crystal-stable Nash equilibrium with negative expected attack utility. Finally, a random voyage across the trust graph converges asymptotically to consensus because the spectral partition barrier prevents trust from leaking into the Sybil region.
